amp.notes: Verses clean/dark with tremolo feel; choruses fuller with overdrive. BPM shown half-time for easier counting.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.content:
Em        G                D             A              Em
 I walk a lonely road, the only one that I have ever known
           G              D                A               Em

          G                D             A               Em
